requirements: R1: Add a docker-compose.yml (or equivalent) to the repository root that starts the full stack.
R2: Expose a health-check endpoint to verify the full stack is running correctly.

slices.title: Add docker-compose.yml for full stack start and health check
slices.jtbd: When implementing the docker setup for this epic, I want to add a docker-compose.yml file, so that the full stack can be started with a single command and verified.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the repository root, When I run docker compose up, Then the full stack (backend, frontend, db) starts.
Given the stack is running, When I ping the health check endpoint, Then it returns a 200 OK status.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce local setup time to < 1 minute

epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce time to local system start by 90%

requirements: R1: Add UI support to update existing materials in the catalog.
R2: Add UI support to delete existing materials from the catalog.

slices.title: Patch existing UI to support updating and deleting materials
slices.jtbd: When implementing the UI updates for this epic, I want to patch the existing UI code to invoke PUT and DELETE API endpoints, so that users can update and delete existing materials.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an existing material, When a user clicks edit and saves changes in the UI, Then a PUT request is sent and the UI reflects the updated material.
Given an existing material, When a user clicks delete in the UI, Then a DELETE request is sent and the material is removed from the UI list.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Increase supported CRUD operations in UI from 50% to 100%

epics.sixSigmaMetric: Increase percentage of materials accurately tracked in system to 100%

requirements: R1: Implement an authentication mechanism blocking unauthenticated access to the catalog.
R2: Implement an authentication mechanism blocking unauthenticated material creation.

slices.title: Patch existing endpoints to enforce authentication
slices.jtbd: When implementing authentication for this epic, I want to patch the existing code to require session authentication, so that unauthorized access and modification are prevented.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an unauthenticated user, When they try to access the catalog, Then they are blocked and prompted to log in.
Given an unauthenticated user, When they try to create a material, Then they are blocked and prompted to log in.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Implement 100% auth coverage on target API routes

epics.title: System Authentication and Session Management
epics.jtbd: When accessing the knowledge base, I want to authenticate my identity, so that restricted epidemiological protocols and data are protected from unauthorized access or modification.
